The [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] '''P-34''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. It was the predecessor to the [[Shark Airspeeder]], employing the same double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turret. Only a prototype, it was never brought to market due to handling problems.
